decision: C has the best central error, three-of-four subject behavior, and lower latency. G_gpu has slightly better P95 and rescues a subject where C is weaker. Use C as the engineering default candidate and retain G_gpu as a high-robustness candidate until product-domain data decides.
next_single_experiment: Frozen C versus frozen G_gpu on failure-enriched product-domain multi-pose RGB-D with independent held-out geometry.
